text:
Maya (CS): Quick weekly health check for HorizonAI — noticed a p99 tail spike on their /generate route over the last 24h after they ramped streaming usage. Posting p95/p99 by route + model below. Can eng/sre triage? :eyes:

latency-bot: Auto-snapshot (24h):
```
Route     | Model         | Mode       | p95   | p99   | errors/hr | spend delta
/generate | gpt-neo-4b    | streaming  | 120ms | 420ms | 0.6%      | +18%
/generate | gpt-neo-4b    | non-stream  | 240ms | 830ms | 0.2%      | +5%
/chat     | redwood-13b   | streaming  | 95ms  | 210ms | 0.1%      | +12%
/chat     | redwood-13b   | non-stream  | 150ms | 490ms | 0.1%      | +4%
```

Maya (CS): Notes — Horizon called out perceived slowness when using streaming responses in their interactive UI. They also saw an unexpected bill jump (approx +18% last invoice).

Owen (SRE): I pulled the traces for a few p99s. Seeing heavy KV cache churn + a couple of worker restarts during autoscale windows. Likely cause: prefix cache misses under bursty streaming sessions. Full trace: https://internal.traces/replay/hd-17485 (link)

Owen (SRE): Quick numbers from node metrics: 3x spikes in L1 miss rate coincide with p99 spikes. No infra OOMs but GC pauses higher on a subset of hosts.

Priya (Eng): Thanks — that aligns with a recent batching tweak we shipped last week (smaller max batch, lower latency tradeoff). Streaming paths ended up hitting more kv lookups per request.

Priya (Eng): /suggestion — revert batching tweak for the streaming executor for Horizon's routed model while we investigate. Alternatively enable prefix caching for their route (targeted).

deploy-bot: deploy rdw-runtime v2025.03.18-rc8 to prod succeeded at 1748501200 (no rollbacks)

Sam (CSE): Customer message: "When dozens of agents stream at once the UI lags and costs spike." They asked for a quick mitigation this week.

Maya (CS): Ok action items:
- Owen: look into KV cache settings + identify hosts with high GC/latency (ETA 3h).
- Priya: prepare rollback or route-scoped prefix caching toggle (ETA 6h).
- Sam: send customer note offering temporary concurrency cap + we’ll monitor (I can draft).

Owen (SRE): On it. I'll also pin p99 traces and add a synthetic job to reproduce streaming bursts.

Priya (Eng): I'll stage a route-scoped toggle and a rollback plan. If we do a toggle, we should see p99 drop within 30m after flip.

Maya (CS): Perfect. Sam, ping me once you've sent the note and I’ll update them after first mitigation.

Sam (CSE): Drafted msg, sending now. Will update thread after confirmation. :white_check_mark:

Maya (CS): Thanks all. Follow-up check-in at EOD with updated p95/p99 snapshots.

latency-bot: Scheduled snapshot job queued for 1748504800

Maya (CS): Marking this high-priority for Horizon — possible renewal risk if we don't show improvement on streaming UX and cost.

Owen (SRE): Agree. Prioritizing.

Priya (Eng): I'll include quantized profiling to see if kernel selection is contributing to GC/latency as well.

Maya (CS): Closing for now, will append EOD metrics. Thanks. :pray:
